requirement_summary:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
prompt: Execute registration for a new citizen user. Verify account creation and email confirmation code generation.
cleanup_strategy: Reset environment to remove test user account
rationale: Validates successful citizen registration and account creation flow as per requirement PT01.

requirement_summary:
As a municipal administrator
I want to configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category
So that interventions will be faster.
prompt: Attempt automatic maintainer assignment without prior configuration. Verify failure response when auto-assignment rules are not set.
setup_needed: Create a report resource via POST /reports
cleanup_strategy: Delete the report resource associated with this assignment
rationale: Tests behavior when automatic assignment is attempted without prior configuration, ensuring safety constraints are enforced.

requirement_summary:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
prompt: Update an existing report status from Pending Approval to Assigned. Verify notification trigger and state transition.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report resource via POST /reports
cleanup_strategy: Delete the report resource associated with this status update
rationale: Validates status transition workflow and notification trigger for resolution process as per requirement PT11.

requirement_summary:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
prompt: Assign an external maintainer to a report. Verify assignment logic respects category constraints (e.g., Public Lighting).
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report resource via POST /reports
cleanup_strategy: Delete the report resource associated with this assignment
rationale: Tests external maintainer assignment logic, including category-specific constraints and spelling variations in endpoint.

requirement_summary:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
prompt: Create an internal comment for a report. Verify comment creation and subsequent listing of comments.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member/external maintainer.
Create a report resource via POST /reports
cleanup_strategy: Delete the report resource associated with this comment creation
rationale: Validates internal comment creation and stateful dependency for listing comments as per requirement PT26.
